title: Ringed Principal Local Tests
statement: For a ringed site with coefficient universe containing its object and arrow universes, define a compatible slice section from one terminal value, local divisibility by a global section using a covering sieve, and the localization test as derived internal Hom from the sheafified localization into exact derived slice restriction. Principal local completeness means zero for all such tests at locally divisible sections. Every slice section is determined by its terminal value; local completeness is invariant under derived isomorphism. Dependencies: [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization], [lem-sf-site-perfect-restriction-exact], [lem-sf-site-perfect-restriction-additive], [lem-sf-site-perfect-derived-restriction-iso].
